verdict.rationale: Fedora's own Workstation page says users can install the best desktop apps with one click from Fedora's repositories or Flathub, and can install, update and manage software packages. A hands-on community report contradicts this for popular apps: installing Discord or Spotify took a page of commands, and some apps never appeared in the app menu. Missing for 10: the built-in store app is never named or described, there is no documented one-click coverage of specific popular apps, and there is no independent confirmation that one-click installs of mainstream apps work.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can install popular desktop apps with a single click from a built-in app store

citations.quote: Easily install the very best desktop apps with the click of a button from Fedora's repositories, Flathub or anywhere else.
Easily install, update and manage software packages
